ex.en: She is respected for her honesty and integrity at work.
ex.zh: 她因工作中的诚实正直而受人尊敬。

words.note: integrity 兼指正直与完整，后者见 territorial integrity。

ex.en: Please refrain from using your phone during the performance.
ex.zh: 演出期间请勿使用手机。

words.note: refrain from 后接动名词，是正式用语。

ex.en: The two countries signed a pact to protect shared rivers.
ex.zh: 两国签署协定，共同保护共有的河流。

words.note: pact 多指国家或团体间的正式协定。

ex.en: The composer wrote the piece using a notation of his own invention.
ex.zh: 作曲家用了自己发明的记谱法来写这首曲子。

words.note: notation 指符号体系，如 musical notation。

ex.en: The two banks merged last year to cut costs.
ex.zh: 两家银行去年合并以削减成本。

words.note: merge 常接 with 或 into；名词 merger 指公司合并。

ex.en: Such old bridges are liable to collapse in an earthquake.
ex.zh: 这样的旧桥在地震中容易坍塌。

words.note: be liable to do 表易于；be liable for 表负责任。

ex.en: Our school recycles paper and plastic bottles every week.
ex.zh: 我们学校每周回收纸张和塑料瓶。

words.note: re- 表再 + cycle 循环；recyclable 是可回收的。

ex.en: The ship docked at the port just before sunset.
ex.zh: 船在日落前靠了港。

words.note: dock 作动词指船靠码头；at the dock 在码头。

ex.en: Thousands of birds nest in the salt marshes along this coast.
ex.zh: 成千上万的鸟在这片海岸的盐沼里筑巢。

words.note: marsh 指常年积水的低湿地；salt marsh 是固定说法。

ex.en: Trust is a key element of any successful partnership.
ex.zh: 信任是任何成功合作的关键要素。

words.note: element 指构成整体的要素；be in one's element 表得心应手。

ex.en: All personal details will be kept strictly confidential.
ex.zh: 所有个人信息将被严格保密。

words.note: confident 是有信心，confidential 是机密的，勿混。

ex.en: There is abundant evidence that exercise lowers stress.
ex.zh: 有大量证据表明锻炼能减轻压力。

words.note: abundant 接不可数或复数名词；be abundant in 表盛产。

ex.en: She exclaimed in surprise when she saw the size of the cake.
ex.zh: 看到蛋糕那么大，她惊讶地叫了起来。

words.note: exclaim 指因强烈情绪喊出，常接 in surprise。

ex.en: She has studied ballet since she was five years old.
ex.zh: 她从五岁起就学习芭蕾舞。

words.note: ballet 的 t 不发音；a ballet 可指一部舞剧。

ex.en: She remained mute throughout the meeting, refusing to answer.
ex.zh: 整场会议她一言不发，拒不作答。

words.note: mute 指不发声；mute the sound 意为消音。

ex.en: It is common courtesy to thank the host before you leave.
ex.zh: 离开前向主人道谢是基本的礼貌。

words.note: courtesy 比 politeness 正式；by courtesy of 表承蒙。

ex.en: His health deteriorated rapidly after he stopped taking the medicine.
ex.zh: 停药后，他的健康状况迅速恶化。

words.note: deteriorate 不及物；名词是 deterioration。

ex.en: The goods were moved to a warehouse outside the city.
ex.zh: 货物被运到城外的一座仓库。

words.note: ware 指货物，house 指房屋，warehouse 指仓库。

ex.en: I hardly recognized her after so many years.
ex.zh: 这么多年过去，我几乎认不出她了。

words.note: recognize 指认出或承认；recognize sb as 表承认身份。

ex.en: The police showed great restraint in dealing with the crowd.
ex.zh: 警方在处理人群时表现出极大的克制。

words.note: restraint 指克制或限制；动词 restrain 常接 from。

ex.en: Factories along the river release pollutants into the water every day.
ex.zh: 沿河的工厂每天向水中排放污染物。

words.note: pollutant 可数；pollute 是动词，pollution 是名词。

ex.en: Pandas spend most of the day eating bamboo.
ex.zh: 熊猫一天中大部分时间都在吃竹子。

words.note: bamboo 不可数，作定语用单数，如 bamboo shoots。

ex.en: We welcome input from everyone before the plan is final.
ex.zh: 计划定稿前，我们欢迎所有人提意见。

words.note: input 指意见或数据时不可数；过去式也可用 inputted。

ex.en: Nothing could induce him to change his mind about leaving.
ex.zh: 什么也不能促使他改变离开的主意。

words.note: induce sb to do 表劝诱；也可指引起某状态。

ex.en: The doctor found nothing abnormal in the test results.
ex.zh: 医生在检查结果中没发现任何异常。

words.note: ab- 表偏离，normal 表正常，故为反常的。

ex.en: She made a shrewd guess about what the manager would decide.
ex.zh: 她对经理会如何决定作出了敏锐的猜测。

words.note: shrewd 褒义，指精明有眼光，比 clever 更实际。

ex.en: The film challenges the stereotype that engineers lack social skills.
ex.zh: 这部电影挑战了工程师缺乏社交能力这一刻板印象。

words.note: stereotype 常与 challenge、break 连用。

ex.en: A water molecule consists of two hydrogen atoms and one oxygen atom.
ex.zh: 一个水分子由两个氢原子和一个氧原子构成。

words.note: molecule 是分子，atom 是原子；形容词 molecular。

ex.en: More than three hundred students enrolled in the evening course.
ex.zh: 三百多名学生报名了这门晚间课程。

words.note: 英式拼作 enrol，美式 enroll；后接 in。

ex.en: He resigned from the board after the scandal became public.
ex.zh: 丑闻公开后，他从董事会辞职。

words.note: resign from 表辞去职务；be resigned to 表无奈接受。
